cause.what_happened: QNC ran +17.0% to $2.20 on 2026-09-28, then announced a C$33.8m cash-and-stock acquisition of Plurilock after the close (16:10 ET). It fell 20.45% on 09-29 and is down another 7.7% at 15:04 ET on 09-30, on 1.05x normal volume, while quantum peers rose ~2% on a BofA IonQ initiation. The market is unwinding the spike and pricing dilution and integration risk in a deal that moves the company from quantum R&D into a low-margin IT/cyber reseller business.

outside_window.finding: Plurilock arrangement special meeting and court approval, expected November 2026. That is the next dated event for the deal and it is well outside the window.

The drawdown is out of scale with the deal's dilution, but nothing dated closes the gap. From the $2.20 close on 09-28 to $1.615 is about -27%, roughly US$128m on 219.4m shares. The deal issues ~4% new equity (~9m shares, ~US$15m at spot) and spends ~C$10m of C$33.5m cash. Even measured from the pre-spike ~$1.88 (09-25 close, implied), the stock is ~14% lower. This is an overshoot with no mechanism, filed here for a longer-horizon reader.
